question:

ground_truth: The seagull glided peacefully to my chair.

I will prepare simple checks (length, character class) and let Reconstruction_Expert propose the sentence; I will then ensure no letters are dropped or shuffled.

mistake_reason: After confirming the correct reconstruction, the Verification_Expert failed to recognize that the task was complete and did not trigger termination. Instead, they continued to propose stylistic refinements, altering the article and plurality (e.g., "These gull glided..."), which violates the constraint to use all letters in order and leads the team away from the correct answer. This unnecessary continuation and absence of the termination signal caused superfluous revisions and an incorrect final output, matching FM-1.5: Unaware of Termination Conditions.
